I am the oldest of the four sisters.|Tera|BotW}} * [[Great Fairy Mija]] {{Small|(second-youngest sister)}}{{Cite|I think my little sister Mija said she was planning to stay near a stable in Hebra north of here...|Great Fairy Kaysa|TotK}} * [[Great Fairy Cotera]] {{Small|(youngest sister)}}{{Cite|I hear my younger sister Cotera is near a stable not far from {{Color TotK|Red|Dueling Peaks}}, off in Necluda to the east.|Great Fairy Kaysa|TotK}} }} |voiceactor= |theme= |counter= }} {{Term/Store|Great Fairy Kaysa||Series, TotK}},{{Exp Game|TotK}}{{Cite|Great Fairy Kaysa|Game Screen|TotK}} also known as {{Term/Store|Kaysa||BotW, AoC}},{{Exp Game|BotW, AoC}}{{Cite|Kaysa|Game Screen|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color AoC|Red|Kaysa}}|Game Screen|AoC}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Biography== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Kaysa is a [[Great Fairy]] who resides in her [[Kaysa's Great Fairy Fountain|Great Fairy Fountain]] on [[Piper Ridge]], which is located on the [[Tabantha Frontier]]. Like the other Great Fairies, Kaysa will upgrade [[Link]]'s [[Armor]] in exchange for [[Material]]s. Kaysa is the subject of the "[[A Gift for the Great Fairy]]" [[Side Quest]]. At the [[Tabantha Bridge Stable]], Link can encounter [[Toren]], who is determined to locate Kaysa's Great Fairy Fountain and meet her. He has heard that the shadow of the [[Tabantha Tower]] points towards the Fountain in the afternoon.{{Cite|There's a tower just beyond the {{Color BotW|Blue|Tabantha Great Bridge}}. They say that if you go to the top and look at the ground sometime in the afternoon... {{Color BotW|Red|The tower's shadow will point}} to the {{Color BotW|Blue|Great Fairy}}'s fountain!|Toren|BotW}} However, he is unable to reach the top of the Tower on his own, so he asks Link to make an offering to Kaysa for him on his behalf.{{Cite|After hearing that legend, I decided to find out for myself. But now I'm stuck here at this stable because... Well... No matter how hard I try, I just know I'll never be able to climb that tower. And to think, I even saved up all my rupees as an offering for the {{Color BotW|Blue|Great Fairy}}. But you... You look like you could climb that tower without breaking a sweat! Would you be willing to make an offering of rupees to the {{Color BotW|Blue|Great Fairy}} on my behalf?|Toren|BotW}} If Link agrees, Toren will give him 500 [[Rupee]]s to give to Kaysa.{{Cite|[I'll do it!] Oh, thank you! Here, take the {{Color BotW|Red|500 rupees}} I saved up. It's my life savings! {{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|So please don't just go running off with it, OK?}}}}|Toren|BotW}} When Link arrives at the Great Fairy Fountain, he will hear the voice of Kaysa inside, asking him to listen to her story.{{Cite|{{Small|Boy...}} Sweet boy... Please... Listen to my story...|Kaysa|BotW}} If Link agrees to listen, she introduces herself and explains that there was once a spring in this location. Over time, the number of travelers visiting to offer Rupees to Kaysa dwindled, and thus her power weakened.{{Cite|But as time passed, fewer and fewer travelers arrived to offer me rupees. As a result, my power has abandoned me.|Kaysa|BotW}} Without her power, she asks Link to give her Rupees.{{Cite|I'm nearly powerless now, so I beg your help. I need rupees to become whole again.|Kaysa|BotW}} Depending on how many Great Fairies Link has already given offerings to, Kaysa will ask for either 100 Rupees,{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|100 rupees}}...|Kaysa|BotW}} 500 Rupees,{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|500 rupees}}...|Kaysa|BotW}} 1,000 Rupees,{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|1,000 rupees}}...|Kaysa|BotW}} or 10,000 Rupees.{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|10,000 rupees}}...|Kaysa|BotW}} She promises to help him after her power has been restored.{{Cite|Once my power has been restored, I can help you do great things, boy.|Kaysa|BotW}} Her hand will then emerge from the bud, and she asks Link to hand over his Rupees.{{Cite|Now... If you have rupees, hand them over to me. Quickly!|Kaysa|BotW}} If Link agrees to give her an offering, Kaysa will thank him for his kindness.{{Cite|Thank you. You are too kind.|Kaysa|BotW}} Her power returns to her, causing her Great Fairy Fountain to bloom once again.{{Cite|Aah... The power... {{Big|It's overflowing!!}}|Kaysa|BotW}} She then emerges from the pool.{{Cite|{{Big|Ah-HAAAAAAAAAAA!!!}}|Kaysa|BotW}} Finally able to see Link, Kaysa notes that she was correct in assuming that he is handsome.{{Cite|Mmm... So you're the one who brought me back from the brink. Oh, my... I see now that my first impression of you was correct. You most definitely are pleasant to look at.|Kaysa|BotW}} She jokingly asks him if he would like to live at the Great Fairy Fountain with her.{{Cite|How would you like to live here with me, hmm?|Kaysa|BotW}} Revealing that she was kidding, Kaysa remarks that Link is cute when he blushes.{{Cite|Hah! I'm kidding, of course. But you certainly are cute when you're blushing.|Kaysa|BotW}} To thank Link for his assistance, she offers to enhance his Armor if he brings her the correct Materials.{{Cite|I really can't thank you enough, boy, but that won't stop me from trying. If you have the {{Color BotW|Red|materials}}needed to enhance a piece of clothing, I will {{Color BotW|Red|enhance}} your {{Color BotW|Red|clothes}}. So why don't you let me take a peek in that little pouch of yours?|Kaysa|BotW}} The degree to which she will be able to enhance Link's Armor depends on how many other Great Fairies have received offerings.{{Cite|With the power available to me... I should be able to enhance your clothing {{Color BotW|Red|a little bit}}.|Kaysa|BotW}}{{Cite|With the power available to me... I can enhance your clothing {{Color BotW|Red|a fair amount}}.|Kaysa|BotW}}{{Cite|With the power available to me... I can {{Color BotW|Red|greatly}} enhance your clothing.|Kaysa|BotW}}{{Cite|With the power available to me... I can enhance your clothing {{Color BotW|Red|to the max}}!|Kaysa|BotW}} When Link selects a piece of Armor to upgrade, Kaysa will tell him to close his eyes as she upgrades it.{{Cite|OK. Got it! Now then... ♪Close your eyes!♪|Kaysa|BotW}} Should Link lack the materials for a requested upgrade, Kaysa will playfully chide him for being impatient{{Cite|You don't have the necessary materials... ♪All in good time, boy.♪|Kaysa|BotW}}, whereas declining an available upgrade has her accuse him of attempting to tease her with the prospect.{{Cite|Teasing me? You little meanie...|Kaysa|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= TotK |type= Characters |category= |needs= * Detailed information on the character's role in the story, including what quests they are involved in * Detailed information on where the character lives and travels to, including at what times they can be found in those locations }} {{Quests|width= 42.3rem| {{TotK Quest |name= Serenade to Kaysa |type= Side Adventure |giver= [[Mastro]] |location= [[Outskirt Stable]] }} }} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Great Fairies Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Artwork of Kaysa with her sisters File:AoC Great Fairies Portrait Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Great Fairies' portrait File:AoC Great Fairies Portrait Icon 2.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Great Fairies' portrait File:AoC Great Fairies Portrait Icon 3.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Great Fairies' portrait File:AoC Great Fairies Portrait Icon 4.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Great Fairies' portrait File:AoC Great Fairies Portrait Icon 5.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Great Fairies' portrait File:AoC Kaysa Portrait Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Kaysa's portrait File:AoC Kaysa Portrait Icon 2.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Kaysa's portrait File:AoC Kaysa Portrait Icon 3.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Kaysa's portrait File:AoC Kaysa Portrait Icon 4.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Kaysa's portrait File:AoC Kaysa Portrait Icon 5.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Kaysa's portrait ==See Also== {{See Also| * Great Fairy * Great Fairy Cotera * Great Fairy Mija * Great Fairy Tera * Kaysa's Great Fairy Fountain * Piper Ridge }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Fairies, Great Fairies |characters= TotK }}
